complaint: The shed door sensor keeps going offline and coming back. Honestly it only started after we put up the new metal shed in October. The app notifies me about it at random times, including at night. I tried moving the sensor to the other side of the door frame, but that made no difference.

logs: 02:00:03 scheduled housekeeping completed (event database vacuum 0.4 s)
06:30:12 radio channel scan: channel 4 selected, utilisation 18%
23:59:20 local app session opened from the home network

user_knowledge.sensor_moved_on_door: Tried the other side of the frame, no change.

action_outcomes.move_device_closer: After moving the base station closer, the device remains online.
action_outcomes.install_repeater: The device stays online after a repeater is installed halfway.
action_outcomes.replace_battery: No change; it still drops offline.
action_outcomes.restart_base_station: The device returns but drops again within a few hours.

notes: Only one peripheral is affected and its RSSI is below -80 dBm. Distractor: Moving the sensor within the frame is irrelevant; the shed blocks the radio path.
